study_strategy.warning: Many Asteraceae look similar from a distance. Use head structure and involucre details, not just a yellow flower photo.

b075_study_strategy.warning: Ray color alone is unreliable in Gaillardia. Habit and stem/leaf architecture are especially useful.

quick_split: G. suavis — perennial basal rosette, long nearly leafless peduncles, fragrant heads, rays reduced or absent; local PASS.
G. amblyodon — annual leafy plant with mostly maroon/red rays lacking bright yellow tips; local PASS.
G. aestivalis — leafy hairy stems, variable yellow/orange/partial rays, upper leaves may clasp; range HOLD.
G. pulchella — existing firewheel anchor, annual with strongly bicolored red/yellow rays.
